substrate_material: stainless-steel sheets coated with a thin SiO 2 film
pretreatment: dip-coating the stainless-steel sheets with acid-catalyzed solutions of tetraethylorthosilicate (TEOS) and ethanol, then annealed in air at 400 °C
evidence: Stainless-steel sheets coated with a thin SiO 2 film were taken as growth substrates for CNT ribbons. The SiO 2 film was obtained by dip-coating the stainless-steel sheets with acid-catalyzed solutions of tetraethylorthosilicate (TEOS) and ethanol, then annealed in air at 400 °C.
